description_html: NVIDIA Networking BU is looking for Senior Software Program Manager that will be responsible for software programs and projects. The PM should drive planning and execution of FW/SW projects while aligning with corporate priorities and constraints.    NVIDIA Mellanox Networking division is a leading supplier of innovative end-to-end InfiniBand and Ethernet connectivity solutions and services for servers and storage. We offer best-in-class solutions that include adapter cards, switches, cables, and software to support networking technologies. Our products optimize data center performance and deliver industry-leading bandwidth and scalability. In addition, we serve a wide range of markets including high-performance computing, enterprise, data centers, cloud computing, big data and Web 2.0. We are constantly reinventing ourselves to stay ahead of the market and bring groundbreaking products and services to the industry. Our product line is focusing on delivering the most optimized Ethernet solutions for industries like Media and Entertainment as well as any other industry that can benefit from our Datastream and TCP/IP acceleration.      What you'll be doing:     You will manage the networking software programs for NVIDIA next generation AI Data centers     Responsible to coordinate between all project stakeholders such as marketing, engineering teams in IL and around the world, operations, etc. from initial requirements definition through Architectural stage, execution, and delivery.    Develop and execute feature planning and prioritization of perception capabilities to meet the software programs' needs    Identify risks, gaps, and bottlenecks in time, and find resolution with technical leaders and project management    Work with product managers, architects, and engineers to ensure consistency with company strategy, commitments, and goals        What we need to see:     B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field    Expert with software project management methodologies and tools    8+ years experience in software project management or leadership    Experience in software development over hardware/Silicon products      Technical orientation, including the ability to conduct technical discussions    Teammate, independent, responsible, capable of multi-tasking, ability to drive people and tasks    Excellent verbal and written communication skills with English proficiency    Ability and willingness to work in a dynamic environment and flexible hours, with teams all over the world        Ways to stand out from the crowd:     Experience with program management tools, preferred AI tools    Networking background    Experience in multiple groups coordination    Familiarity with SW Agile concept      If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you! NVIDIA is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.    NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most talented and forward-thinking individuals in the world working for us.

title: Senior Enterprise Architect
description_html: The delivery Enterprise Architect (EA) serves as the primary technical driver for delivering high quality Digital Experience and Digital Marketing solutions for Adobe's Global Enterprise customers. Review and develop architectural plans, lead diverse delivery team, align with client goals.   Minimum Qualifications               Past experience in a consultative role leading large-scale enterprise digital marketing ecosystems in the role of Architect and/or Principal Consultant.    4+ years' experience hands-on architecting and/or implementing  three or more  of the following Adobe Experience Cloud solution categories:    Adobe Analytics or Customer Journey Analytics    Adobe Journey Optimizer, Adobe Campaign or Marketo Engage    Adobe Real-Time CDP or Audience Manager    Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) including App Builder    Adobe Commerce/Magento or another e-commerce solution that integrated with AEM    Adobe Target or Recommendations    Adobe Experience Platform (Schema, Query Services, etc.)    Adobe Workfront Workflow, Planning, or Fusion    GenStudio, Express, or Firefly Services (< 3 years)      Strong leadership abilities (an example being proactively convert complex business requirements into technical "solutions") which aligns all delivery team activities to documented customer Business Objectives.    Experience producing project scope definitions, delivery estimations, resource allocation and project timelines based on product licensing purchase and implementation requirements.    Ability to quickly diagnose delivery challenges and formulate effective remediation plans to adhere to scope, schedule and budget.    Demonstrable hands-on experience using enterprise platforms (Adobe, Salesforce, Oracle, Microsoft, etc.) with an emphasis on REST APIs, Cloud Storage, Structured/Unstructured Data, Security and Data Ingress/Egress.    Experience leading cross-functional, multi-region delivery teams.    Proficient in written and verbal communications with the ability to adjust communications as needed for Technical, Marketing and/or C-Suite customers.    Ability to travel up to 20% of the time within the United States and occasionally internationally.    Bachelor's degree in Computer Science (CS), Digital Marketing or MBA or equivalent experience.       Skills that Set You Apart     One or more current Adobe Certified Expert certifications (AEM, AJO, Analytics/CJA, RTCDP, Target or Workfront)    Working knowledge of end-to-end digital marketing journey including Ad Tech (CDP/DMPs, DSPs, etc.), Marketing Automation, omni-channel personalization, Content Management or automation, CRM, Media Execution, and Reporting/Insights.    Hands-on experience architecting and/or delivering native, Flutter or React-Native mobile applications.    Proficiency in employing Generative and/or Agentic AI solutions to optimize daily workflows or hands-on experience with building AI agents. title: Senior Enterprise Architect
description_html: The Solutions Architect guides the design and delivery of high-quality Digital Experience and Digital Marketing solutions for Adobe’s global enterprise customers. This role brings deep expertise in Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) and focuses on crafting scalable, digital experiences centered around content.  You will define architecture strategy, lead multi-functional teams, and deliver solutions that align with client goals, technical requirements, and long-term digital transformation outcomes.     Minimum Qualifications     Experience in a consultative role leading large-scale enterprise digital marketing ecosystems as an Architect or Principal Consultant, with significant proficiency in Adobe Experience Manager (AEM)    More than four years of experience crafting and delivering AEM-based solutions, including Sites, Assets, and integrations across Adobe Experience Cloud    4+ years of experience working with multiple Adobe Experience Cloud solutions, with AEM as a core capability, across three or more of the following:    Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), including Sites, Assets, and App Builder    Adobe Analytics or Customer Journey Analytics    Adobe Journey Optimizer, Adobe Campaign, or Marketo Engage    Adobe Real-Time CDP or Audience Manager    Adobe Commerce/Magento or comparable e-commerce platforms    Adobe Target or Recommendations    Hands-on experience with Adobe's data management and querying tools such as Schema and Query Services.    Adobe Workfront (Workflow, Planning, or Fusion)    GenStudio, Express, or Firefly Services (less than 3 years)          Ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable, technical solutions built on AEM that align teams to customer business objectives    Experience defining project scope, delivery estimates, resource plans, and timelines based on implementation and licensing requirements    Ability to identify delivery challenges early and develop clear, practical solutions to maintain scope, schedule, and budget    Experience working with enterprise platforms (Adobe, Salesforce, Oracle, Microsoft), including:    AEM integrations using REST APIs    Cloud platforms and storage    Structured and unstructured data flows    Security and data movement          Experience leading teams across engineering, architecture, and business functions that are multi-functional and geographically distributed    Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain AEM architecture and Experience Cloud solutions to technical, marketing, and executive audiences    Ability to travel up to 20% domestically and occasionally internationally    Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Digital Marketing, Business, or equivalent experience       Skills That Set You Apart     Adobe Certified Expert certifications, with preference for AEM
